lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: proving the Pythagorean theorem using similarity
lessonRef.title: Reteach and varied practice: proving the Pythagorean theorem using similarity

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: These two examples show the same idea in two different formats.

items.prompt: A 2 m pole casts a 3 m shadow; a tree casts a 12 m shadow. Tree height?
Why does a line parallel to one side divide the others proportionally?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 8 corresponds to DE = 16. If BC = 7, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 4 and 36. Find the altitude.
A 5 m pole casts a 3 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 6 m shadow. How tall is the building?
Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The criterion holds only when the ratio is a whole number.
Equal ratios of sides guarantee congruence, not similarity.
This is the SSS congruence criterion applied directly.
This is the SSS similarity criterion: a dilation matches one triangle’s sides to the other’s, and the resulting figures are congruent.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 9 corresponds to DE = 18. If BC = 7, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 4 and 16. Find the altitude.
A 3 m pole casts a 5 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 10 m shadow. How tall is the building?
A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.
The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.
The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 9 corresponds to DE = 45. If BC = 3, find EF.
